descriptions.en: Optional aspect prefix with trailing space; empty string when unused
descriptions.zh-CN: 可选画幅前缀，自带尾部空格；不用则空字符串

inputs.name: setting
examples: small industrial town in Vermont, pre-dawn October night, nearly deserted back street, old red-brick warehouses, wet cracked asphalt reflecting one sodium streetlight, dark wooded hills in the distance, faint church steeple

descriptions.en: Town, time of day and weather in one phrase; darkness and available-light sources must come from the scene itself
descriptions.zh-CN: 小镇、时刻与天气一句；黑暗与可用光源由场景自带

inputs.name: subjects
examples: two ordinary middle-aged graffiti writers quietly working on a weathered brick wall, one standing and one crouching, worn work clothes, subtle spray-paint stains

descriptions.en: The ordinary people and their quiet activity in one phrase, including wardrobe and honest traces of labor
descriptions.zh-CN: 普通人物与其安静动作一句，含衣着与劳作痕迹
